notes:
Context: mid-market product analytics SaaS; building in-app assistant + search. Running Hosted API trial to validate UX and rough cost before committing to Dedicated. Team: Product Eng (5), ML infra (2), Security (1), Finance/Procurement involved for pricing.

Hosted API trial findings (observed):
- Avg QPS during demo traffic: 9.2 QPS (baseline test flows)
- 95th percentile burst QPS observed: 68 QPS (concurrent users during Friday peak tests)
- Measured concurrency on service: typical 12 concurrent streams, stress to 42 in replay tests
- Token mix per request (trial sample): ~65 prompt tokens / ~145 generated tokens => ~210 tokens total (prompt:gen ≈ 30:70)
- Embeddings traffic: intermittent batched jobs, ~2k embedding calls/day in trial; small token footprint but high QPS in short windows (bursty).
- Latency targets: target p95 <= 350ms for chat small responses; current hosted p95 ~280-320ms depending on model.

Forecast & sizing notes (customer expectations):
- Expected production steady-state QPS: 35-45 QPS after rollout (US region), with bursts up to ~220 QPS for promo events.
- Concurrency target for Dedicated: design for 60 concurrent inference streams to allow headroom for retries and long-form generates.
- Monthly token forecast (initial): ~150M-220M tokens/mo (grows with feature adoption — customer models 3-4x growth in 6 months).
- Model preference: open/quantized medium-sized models for cost control; will test 13B- to 7B-class quantized variants. Open to Redwood recommendations.

POC / Dedicated ask from GoldenMarsh:
- Sizing recommendation that maps QPS/concurrency/token mix -> GPU pool recommendation and estimated cost (monthly committed and burst pricing).
- Confirm fallback routing: hosted -> dedicated -> lower-cost model variant during overload. Need policy examples.
- VPC + KMS options required for enterprise customers; legal wants residency option for EU customers.

Pricing sensitivity / procurement notes:
- Finance: target TCO must be <= 25% increase vs current managed-provider spend to justify migration.
- Interested in reserved capacity pricing with predictable commit + monthly true-ups.

Quotes / customer voice: "If we can lock in predictable latency for our in-app assistant and get a clear cost per 1k tokens for our traffic mix, we can commit to dedicated capacity by November."

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to provide Dedicated capacity workbook mapping trial metrics -> node counts + cost (action: SE Liam O'Connor).
- GoldenMarsh to provide 7-day production trace (anonymized) to refine QPS distribution for EU/US (action: Product Eng).
- Legal to review residence clauses; security follow-up for SOC2 artifacts (support ticket SEC-2087).
